رأيت ليلة أسري بي موسى رجلا

notes: two sayings: the Prophet's dream report with two routes (the first ends at Qatada with no Companion written; the second, «وقال لي خليفة», carries the matn), and the later «تحرس الملائكة» saying with its own transmitters (rule 4a)
«يعني ابن عباس» is an editor's gloss; the surface is «ابن عم، نبيكم» as written
the Prophet is the end of each chain
